step1_analysis.description: A voltage reference circuit that uses an error amplifier (XM3, XM4, XM6, XM7) and an output stage (XM9) in a feedback loop to buffer a reference voltage. The reference voltage is generated by the diode-connected PMOS (XM1) and source-follower NMOS (XM5), producing an output VREF ≈ VDD - Vsg1 - Vgs5.

paper_reference.title: CMOS Voltage Reference Based on Gate Work Function Differences in Poly-Si Controlled by Conductivity Type and Impurity Concentration

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the theoretical derivation for the stacked Vsg/Vgs drop from VDD. The calculated 0.87V aligns remarkably well with the paper's reported 0.88V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vth decreases by ~2mV/C. Since VREF = VDD - Vsg - Vgs, VREF will increase by ~4mV/C. The original paper used work-function differences to cancel this, which standard SKY130 models do not replicate without specific flavor mixing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard devices will show a positive TC due to the subtraction of two negative-TC Vth values from a constant VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: dVREF/dVDD ≈ 1 V/V since VREF is directly derived from VDD minus relatively constant Vgs drops.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without a pre-regulator, this topology inherently tracks VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Testbench adds 4x 1uA bias currents + op-amp current (~1uA). Total current ~5uA. Power = 1.8V * 5uA = 9uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the artificial bias currents added to the testbench to ensure the floating nodes (N5, V2, N6) are properly biased for simulation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC reference voltage, temperature coefficient, line regulation, and power consumption. Bias currents are added to resolve floating nodes and establish the intended operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Voltage Reference Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameterized W/L
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM9 VREF N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM4 N1 V3 N6 N6 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM7 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM3 N0 V2 N6 N6 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM5 VDD N5 V2 V2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM1 N5 N5 VDD N5 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM8 N6 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Supplies and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Close the op-amp feedback loop
V_V3 V3 VREF 0
* Bias currents to establish operating points for floating/unbiased nodes
I_N5 N5 0 1u
I_V2 V2 0 1u
I_tail N6 0 1u
I_load VREF 0 1u

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
  print pwr
  let vref_nom = v(VREF)
  print vref_nom

  * 2. Line Regulation (Sweep VDD)
  dc VVDD 1.6 2.0 0.01
  meas dc vref_16 find v(VREF) at=1.6
  meas dc vref_20 find v(VREF) at=2.0
  let line_reg = (vref_20 - vref_16) / 0.4
  print line_reg

  * 3. Temperature Coefficient (Sweep Temp)
  dc temp -40 85 1
  meas dc vref_max max v(VREF)
  meas dc vref_min min v(VREF)
  let tc_abs = (vref_max - vref_min) / 125
  print tc_abs

  quit
.endc
.end
